descriptions.w3d_d16a_entity_raised_position_80026668: Returns (by hidden result pointer) the position of the entity referenced by the caller object's handle at +32, raised by 8 on y: views the handle (0x803426b4), resolves its index (0x80178c48) and entity record (0x800fc6dc), copies the record's Vec3 at +80 into a local through a pointer, builds the offset (0, 8, 0) from the pooled literals 0x8036ca50/0x8036ca54 and returns the component-wise sum. Names are inferred; offsets are observed.
